title: Contacts Backup and Restore
summary: Create backup of your contacts on phone and restore or transfer to other phone
description:
Contact Backup and Restore app - Transfer Contacts safely

With Contacts Backup, you can easily create a contact backup and keep your information secure.🔄💾👤🗂️📲

Contact backup app allows you to back up contacts, store them securely on Google Drive or Dropbox, and recover contacts effortlessly on any device.

Moving to a new phone or resetting your current one will always protect your contacts with the My Contacts Backup app.

Contact Backup and Restore app Key Features:
💾👤Backup Contacts Across Devices
Creating a contact backup is easy! With Transfer Contacts Backup app, you can securely store your contact data on local storage, Google Drive, or Dropbox.

💾👤Restore Contacts with Ease
Are you switching to a new device? With Contact Backup and Restore app, you can quickly and easily restore contacts on any phone.

💾👤Recover Contacts After Phone Loss or Reset
Lost your phone or had to reset it? No worries! Log into your account and recover contacts with a few taps. My contacts backup ensures your data remains secure even during device loss or reset.

💾👤Share and Transfer Contacts Easily
This app is always ready when you need it. With transfer contacts & backup, sharing or transferring your contact list is simple. Whether you need to share contacts with friends or transfer them to a new phone, contacts backup makes the process fast and efficient. My contacts backup feature lets you transfer contact data across devices.

💾👤Schedule Automatic Backups
Forget about manually creating backups. With transfer contacts & backup, you can schedule automatic contacts backup weekly, fortnightly, or monthly. You’ll never have to worry about losing your important contact data again!

How to Backup:
1. Choose where to store your contacts backup (local storage, Google Drive, or Dropbox).
2. Select whether to back up phone numbers only or all contact details.
3. Your contacts backup will be created in seconds.

How to Restore contacts:
1. Choose the backup source.
2. Tap restore contacts and follow the instructions.
3. Your contacts will be restored quickly and easily!

Contact Backup and Restore app Advanced Features:
1. Auto Backup: Schedule automatic backups to keep your contact data up to date. This feature ensures that you tranfer contacts & backup the data safely.
2. View, Search, & Sort Contacts: Easily find and manage contacts in your contacts backup files with advanced search and sorting tools.
3. Transfer Contacts Between Devices: Use my contacts backup to transfer or share contacts across multiple devices effortlessly.

Keep Your Data Safe:
With transfer contacts & backup, you’ll receive reminders to create regular backups, keeping your contact information secure at all times. Whether you need to recover contacts after losing a phone or need a quick restore contacts option, this one is for you. Transfer Contacts Backup app has you covered. You can easily transfer contacts & backup the data, so it is always protected.

Download Contacts Backup Today!
Protect your contact list from unexpected loss or damage. Download Contacts Backup now to securely back up, transfer, and restore contacts whenever necessary. You’ll be peaceful knowing that your data is always safe and accessible - back up, restore or transfer contacts with this app!
